name: Demo_Lock
author: Infantry AI
description: The demo policy preset (policies/demo.json: which actions the demo turns off and why, its seats, turn limit and notice; read by the daemon) and, in the demo build, the demo notice around the app for Demo_Banner. The dimming itself is core's policy gate; its daemon half (daemon/) is the seated lockdown: the visitor token, the per-IP turn limit, the seeded sessions and their warm-up.
